info.title: ScrapeBadger GitHub Profile API
info.description: Prepared contract for public user and organization profiles. Production availability and latency are not yet verified. All examples are representative. Every mode costs 10 credits.

servers.description: API base URL; rollout verification pending

tags.name: GitHub
tags.description: Global public profiles; no market or language parameter.

get.description: Get public website profile sections plus supplemental public metadata. tab defaults overview. year is overview-only, page repositories-only, next_page_token stars-only. HTML sections remain required; failed native reads are errors, never empty successes. General search, standalone repository detail, trending and private member views are excluded.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: GitHub login or leading @handle, not a profile URL. Up to 39 login characters; reserved site routes and invalid logins are rejected.

parameters.name: tab
parameters.description: Profile mode. Stars supports user accounts only.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Overview only: 1970 through the current UTC year; activity is December or current month

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Repositories only. Positive page number; 30 repository rows per page. Follow pagination.next_page.

parameters.name: next_page_token
parameters.description: Stars only. Exact opaque pagination.next_page_token from the prior response; not a URL. 30 rows per page.

200.description: Unwrapped profile object. Source-specific sections may be omitted. Representative examples are abridged and not live production results.

overview.summary: Abridged representative user overview; not a production result

repositories.summary: Representative repository page; not a production result

stars.summary: Representative stars pagination shape; not a production result

400.description: Invalid parameter combination, invalid login, or organization stars.

401.description: Missing or invalid ScrapeBadger API key.

502.description: Upstream transport, challenge or parser failure; unbilled.

503.description: Source unavailable or transport not configured; unbilled.

next_page_token.description: Opaque cursor for the stars tab only.
next_page_token.title: Next Page Token

utc_offset.description: Public profile UTC offset in hours.
utc_offset.title: Utc Offset

followers.description: Exact when public metadata is available.
followers.title: Followers

GitHubProfileResponse.description: Unwrapped profile response, with mode-specific public sections.

contributions.description: Public user overview only; omitted for organizations and other tabs.

GitHubProfileResponse.title: GitHubProfileResponse
